description: Implementation of a hardware scheduler for the native simulator, managing events, signals, and timing.

methods.name: nsi_hws_signal_end_handler
methods.description: Signal handler for SIGTERM and SIGINT, sets a flag to indicate termination request.

methods.name: nsi_hws_set_sig_handler
methods.description: Sets up signal handlers for SIGTERM and SIGINT with SA_RESETHAND flag.

methods.name: nsi_hws_sleep_until_next_event
methods.description: Advances simulation time to the next event and checks for termination signals.

methods.name: nsi_hws_find_next_event
methods.description: Finds the next scheduled hardware event based on timers.

methods.name: nsi_hws_get_next_event_time
methods.description: Returns the time of the next scheduled event.

methods.name: nsi_hws_one_event
methods.description: Executes the next hardware event and updates the scheduler.

methods.name: nsi_hws_init
methods.description: Initializes the hardware scheduler, registers signal handlers, and finds the first event.

methods.name: nsi_hws_cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up resources used by the hardware scheduler (empty implementation).
